title: Cubic-scale learner parameter
statement: For natural numbers $n,\ell$ and a rational parameter $\delta$ with $0<\delta\leq 1/2$, define the scale to be $2^\ell\big((\ell+1)(n+1)^\ell + b(\delta)+2\big)$, where $b(\delta)$ is the failure-bit count associated with the Fourier estimator.
caveat: The failure-bit count is referenced but not defined in the supplied snippet.
